mapper.select: SELECT t.id task_id,t.space_id,t.creator_id actor_id,t.conversation_id,b.workspace_id,b.root_scope_id, coalesce(p.mode,'RISK_BASED') mode,coalesce(p.version,1) version,coalesce(p.policy_version,'task-directory-policy-v1') policy_version, t.status,t.cancel_requested,t.plan_mode,clock_timestamp() now FROM pf.task t LEFT JOIN pf.task_resource_binding b ON b.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN pf.task_permission p ON p.task_id=t.id WHERE t.space_id=#{space} AND t.id=#{task}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND state='READY')

SELECT id,relative_path path FROM pf.file_entry WHERE space_id=#{space} AND workspace_id=#{workspace} AND kind='DIRECTORY' AND collection_state='CONFIRMED' AND relative_path > #{after} ORDER BY relative_path LIMIT 51
SELECT id,relative_path path FROM pf.file_entry WHERE space_id=#{space} AND workspace_id=#{workspace} AND id=#{id} AND kind='DIRECTORY' AND collection_state='CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.task_permission(task_id,space_id,mode) VALUES(#{task},#{space},#{mode}) ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.task_permission SET mode=#{mode},version=version+1 WHERE task_id=#{task} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE pf.task_permission SET version=version+1 WHERE task_id=#{task} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id,scope_id,directory_path path,capabilities::text capabilities,expires_at,revoked_at,policy_version FROM pf.task_directory_grant WHERE space_id=#{space} AND task_id=#{task} ORDER BY created_at,id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.task_directory_grant(id,task_id,space_id,workspace_id,actor_id,scope_id,directory_path,capabilities,policy_version,created_at,expires_at) VALUES(#{id},#{p.taskId},#{p.spaceId},#{p.workspaceId},#{p.actorId},#{scope},#{path},#{caps}::jsonb,#{policy},CAST(#{p.now} AS timestamptz),CAST(#{p.now} AS timestamptz)+interval '24 hours')
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.task_directory_grant SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{space} AND task_id=#{task} AND id=#{grant} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,response_json::text response_json FROM pf.task_permission_command WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND task_id=#{task} AND command_id=#{key}
SELECT o.id FROM pf.tool_operation o JOIN pf.operation_execution_binding b ON b.operation_id=o.id WHERE o.task_id=#{task} AND b.attempt_id=#{attempt} AND o.call_id=#{call}
